propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must block at plan-review and completion-verification gates before any LLM execution or child checks.
The [verify] configuration must enforce a typed, positive-integer maximum-description setting with a default of 8,000 characters; exactly 8,000 is admitted and 8,001 blocks.
Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false for oversized tickets; light-bug-tier review retains the P4 description block while downgrading other DET findings to advisory.
Completion verification must return a validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls upon detecting an authoritative description exceeding the configured maximum.
Historical calibration from 2,202 work tickets shows 18 tickets (0.82%) at or above 8,000 characters, with materially worse latency and lower PASS rates in that cohort.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; neither gate truncates or summarizes content, and operator force override remains available.
